meaning: Everything a side fights with: gear, levels, prayers, spell, food, potion and Setup entries. Also the Setup tab, where it is changed.
One of the two setups in a comparison, named A or B.
One simulation of a setup against a set of targets; its results are saved and can be opened again. Also the verb: to simulate.
One simulated stretch of fighting a target; a run repeats trials and averages them.
A monster, dungeon, Slayer task or Slayer master that a run fights.
A Slayer master, simulated as a target: its tasks fought in turn, weighted by how long each takes.
A Slayer task blocked with a master, so the master never gives it.
A saved set of gear and settings in the game's Loadouts; a side can start from one.
A side made of the player's setup with changes, owned or not, to see what they would do.
CS2's search for the gear, prayers and other choices that do best against a target.
An answer of Best setup that does as well while using less, such as fewer consumables.
An answer of Best setup that does as well while taking less damage.
The setting that hides monsters and places the character hasn't seen yet, shown as ???.
The hidden second copy of the game where CS2 runs its fights, so the game being played doesn't slow down.
A copy of the player's character in which fights are simulated; the game being played is never touched.
